items.text: Forensic science career options in India split into eight genuinely different tracks, not one crime-scene job.
This is where pay starts pulling well ahead of the government lab-science ladder.

blocks.heading: Four of the Eight Tracks

items.text: The most common entry point, filled through a state recruitment exam (UPSSSC, a state PSC, or a department-specific test), not a campus placement.
Requires clearing a genuinely competitive written exam plus interview, usually after an NFSU or other recognised forensic science degree.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Track 1: the government FSL ladder (biology, toxicology, ballistics, documents)

items.text: This is the track most forensic science career searches never surface, because it is filed under "cybersecurity" as often as "forensic science." It is also, by pay and by employer growth, the strongest track on this entire list right now.
Entry-level work: imaging drives, extracting call/chat logs, and running first-pass analysis under a senior analyst's review.
Owns full case investigations end to end: mobile and cloud forensics, malware triage, and writing reports built to survive cross-examination in court.

blocks.heading: Toxicology Ballistics and Questioned

items.text: Toxicology, ballistics, and questioned documents follow the same four-rung government FSL ladder described above.
Analyses blood, viscera, and other samples for poisons, drugs, and alcohol in suspicious-death and NDPS (narcotics) cases.
Matches bullets, cartridge cases, and weapons to specific crimes.

items.text: Forensic biology and DNA analysis is the one most people picture, but digital and cyber forensics, forensic accounting, toxicology, ballistics, questioned documents, forensic psychology, and forensic anthropology each run through a different degree, a different employer base, and a different pay ceiling.

Building a real high-value skill portfolio inside the specific track that fits you, not a generic "forensic science degree," is what actually unlocks higher income opportunities and earlier financial freedom here.

blocks.heading: Education Budget for Forensic Science Career Options
Budget Check: Forensic Science

figures.label: Budget Warning Threshold
figures.source: A B.Sc or M.Sc Forensic Science from a private college teaches the same core subjects regardless of college, but only a genuinely recognised degree, and a cleared recruitment exam, gets you into a government FSL seat. The degree name alone does not. As a starting planning rule, treat anything materially above roughly 10% of your total education budget on a forensic-science-specific private degree as needing real justification, accreditation, verified placement into an actual FSL or industry role, not brochure claims, before spending it.
